findings: Iteration 1 KEEP: vectorizing the PTQ1_0 qh 8-trit scalar tail (threshold decode) raised board tg 0.80 -> 0.86 t/s (+7.5%), bit-exact. Committed 21106d58e.
Plateau reached: dot fp-reduction (vpaddq), skip-x1 multiply, and 2-block unroll all show no gain on the A76 standalone microbench (~2.10-2.11x), so they were not board-verified.
Kernel is at its practical throughput floor on this CPU: unpack is ~5 NEON ops/16-trit (near-minimal), OoO already covers single-block ILP, dot fp overhead is small.
Overall PTQ1_0 decode: 0.38 (scalar) -> 0.86 t/s = 2.26x across all optimization work.
